result.explanation: Use a finite controller state: last observation time, acknowledged IDs, mode, normal hysteresis counters, and current warning. Critical observations take precedence unless their ID was acknowledged.
result.mapping: config.low/high/dwell map to hysteresis thresholds and persistence. State maps to lastTime, acknowledgements, enabled mode, counters, and visible warning. Events map to ordered transitions; output is the resulting warning projection.
result.assumptions: The host supplies the same config on each call and passes returned JSON state unchanged. Event types are valid under the specification. IDs are compared by exact string equality.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(const x of output){if(!x||typeof x!=="object"||typeof x.visible!=="boolean"||!(x.kind===null||x.kind==="normal"||x.kind==="critical"))return false;if(x.visible!==(x.kind!==null))return false;if(x.kind==="critical"&&typeof x.id!=="string")return false;if(x.kind!=="critical"&&x.id!==null)return false}return true}
